name: OpenClaw
description: What OpenClaw, the personal AI agent, does on this machine: sessions running now, usage and its cost as OpenClaw records it, by day, project and model, each session's conversation, its agents' memory and its scheduled jobs. Read from OpenClaw's own databases and workspace, nothing saved; one step gives it the vault's tools.
author: Vaultite

openclaw-memory.description: an agent's memory, read only: its identity, soul, what it knows of the user, its long-term memory and its latest daily notes
openclaw-memory.live: the agent's workspace on the machine the server runs on

notes.description: how many of the latest daily notes to show

account.description: another agent's (its id); main when left out

machine.description: another machine's (its id in the Machines plugin's list)

openclaw-cron.description: its scheduled jobs: when each runs, its last run and the next
openclaw-cron.live: OpenClaw's shared database on the machine the server runs on

account.description: one agent's jobs (its id, like main); all of them when left out

machine.description: another machine's (its id in the Machines plugin's list)
